Name: Eevee Cat Replacer for Alternative Textures
Author: AlexanderSeraph
Description:
[size=4]UPDATE:

[size=6][b]Good news everyone!

[/b][/size][size=3]1.0.3 is the latest update. I know it's been a long time since I updated it. I'm sorry everyone. This time, I have updated the sprites editing the images myself in order to delete some of the shadows. I didn't give myself enough time to do them all, as large portions of my life changed since the last update. [/size]







Pardon me, this is my first "mod." I say that in quotes because I didn't do any real coding, just setting up the files necessary and limited tags attaching items to each other.
[/size]
[size=6][b]Requirements:[/b]
[/size][size=5]This does require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description][Alternative Textures] [/url]in order to function properly﻿﻿, in addition to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][SMAPI][/url][/size][size=4]
[/size]
I found the other Eevolution sprites all across Nexus so far, and am working on getting the sprites for the ones I don't have yet.

I am not sure when this will be updated again, but I'm working on it. I do have a more than full time job, and a lot of responsibilities, so I apologize if this takes a bit longer than I intended.

These are the authors whom found the sprites before me, and let me use their work.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67314851]ArcaneDesu[/url] - Flareon
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3655154]VdotV[/url] - Umbreon, Eevee, Shiny Eevee
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53698301]terrabubbles[/url] - Sylveon, Leafeon, Glaceon
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46705038?tab=about+me]linasouls9[/url] - Jolteon, Shiny Sylveon, Vaporeon, Shiny Vaporeon
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45407192]EveriasArt[/url] - Espeon

I would appreciate it if anyone could help me find the sprite sheets, easily accessible, and you will be credited for the ones that I add in return.

[size=5][i]To everyone: If you are a sprite sheet artist, and willing to do up the eevolutions that I do not have, I am willing to add any/all of them here. You will be credited. I opted out of donations because I don't know how to share donations, so I will not profit from your works, as you will still own them.

Permissions: You can not use this mod in other mod packs. You may use it in collections. You shall not sell this mod. You will credit original artists as necessary.

[/i][/size][size=6][b]KNOWN BUGS:

[/b][/size][size=4]Linux and Mac seem to be having issues with this mod. Please try changing the textures folder to Textures and see if that helps before posting here. Seems to be a problem with the computer lowercasing the first letter. Idk if that's really what's going on though.


[/size]

Downloads.Description: This version is removing some *not all* of the shadows accompanying the sprites, using my own edits. I didn't get to give myself enough time to do them all.
